description: This file is a shell script responsible for configuring device mode and network routing on a device. It manages DNS configurations, routing rules for IPv4 and IPv6, and device mode transitions, particularly in relation to mesh networks and cellular interfaces.

methods.name: update_v4route
methods.description: Updates IPv4 routing rules and DNS configurations based on cellular and device mode states.

methods.name: update_v6route
methods.description: Updates IPv6 routing rules and DNS configurations based on cellular and device mode states.

methods.name: update_dns_conf
methods.description: Modifies the /etc/resolv.conf file and backup variables with specified DNS servers for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: sync_dns
methods.description: Synchronizes both IPv4 and IPv6 DNS configurations based on current system settings.

methods.name: set_dummy_route
methods.description: Sets up dummy network routes for fallback or testing purposes.
